title: Dashboard: header Loop ghosts/repeats ~20x on tmux pane reflow (Ink repaint bug)
description:
COSMETIC-ONLY TUI bug (no loop-correctness impact). The dashboard summary section heading "Loop" (src/ui/Dashboard.tsx:381, heading="Loop", gapTop=0 so it is the first line of the frame) ghosts and stacks ~20 orphaned copies above the live frame.

ROOT CAUSE (not a data/label bug; the event feed and Recent panel render correctly): Inks in-place repaint tracks the previous frames line count at the OLD terminal width. When cam-runs window-resized hook reflows the column (tmux pane resize / SIGWINCH bursts), that count is stale and the top line (the "Loop" header) is left ghosted. The code already documents this exact failure mode at src/commands/dashboard.ts:948-957 and 1030-1039.

WHY THE CURRENT MITIGATION MISSES IT: makeResizeClearer (src/commands/dashboard.ts:970-1005) only writes a clear on the resize event. The poll-driven re-render (src/ui/Dashboard.tsx:144-149, fires every poll interval) repaints with NO clear at all. So a poll repaint at a stale height, or a tmux pane resize that never surfaces as a process.stdout resize event inside the pane, leaves the ghosts stacked.

CANDIDATE FIX (spec later, do not implement from this issue): add a clear/repaint-reset to the poll-driven re-render path, or force a full-frame clear when the rendered height changes, not only on the resize event. Verify against a real tmux pane reflow, not a fake.

Evidence: operator screenshot 2026-07-15 showing ~20 Loop rows above the state/story/progress block.
